title: Great Priorat tour
text: Tour guide Toni was excellent. This was my 2nd tour with the company. Pricey but well worth it. You won’t regret.
author: Michael_W

title: Outstanding private tours
text: My husband and I booked two private wine tours from Barcelona with Castlexperience.  Both tours were outstanding and worth the cost.  The guides, Victor and Javi, were personable and very knowledgeable about wine.  By the time the tours were over, we felt like they were our friends.  We've traveled all over the world, and the lunches on the tours were some of the best we've ever had.  We enjoyed learning about the local grapes as well as the process for making cava.  The wineries we visited provided high quality samples with no pressure to buy, but we ended up buying a few bottles to take home
author: HB7117

title: Relaxing, a tour for the senses
text: Discussing wine production with the Vintner while in the vineyard. Very knowledgeable. Really became aware of the complications of preparing wine... truly scientific and artful because conditions are different very year. The tasting was also very personal with the Vintner discussing the the taste of the wine as we ate different cheeses and bread. Been on many wine tours but i learned more on this tour than any others.
author: James_D

title: Priorat wineries worth the trip
text: Our guide Pol was outstanding and the perfect host. Both wineries were hospitable, insightful, educational and fun. Dual winery was exceptional. We would highly recommend this as it was the highlight of our vacation. Not cheap but well worth the expense.
author: Pawood48

title: Priorat Tour
text: Our guide, Paul, and winemaker, Antonio, were outstanding. They were extremely knowledgeable, and the wines were delicious.
author: James_B
